Description: "Bound by fire to forever walk this land."

Name: Ashen Dark Staff
Description: "When the lights go out, who will be your ally?"

Name: Ash to Dust
Description: "Your remains shall be scattered to the winds. You shall be forgotten."

Name: Awoken Ash Staff
Description: "Dark ash covers the light wood creating a messy appearance."

Name: Burning Void
Description: "Do not let the darkness fool you. The void burns all the same."

Name: Caputah, Gaze of Serpens
Description: “Alone, enraged, and afraid it wandered the halls following the scent of arcane power."

Name: Cauterization
Description: "Fire will purify your wound."

Name: Corrupted Mage's Spellstaff
Description: "Forbidden magic is imbued heavily into this staff, enchanted by a rebellious sorcerer eons ago."

Name: Corruption's Flame
Description: "We shall wash over this world like a raging wildfire. Nothing will be left when we are finished."

Name: Duality
Description: "Fire and ice, one complements the other."

Name: Elegant Lamplighter
Description: "Light the village and keep the dark things away."

Name: Enmity
Description: "We look upon each other as enemies, but it goes deeper than that. It is a deep, seething darkness that knows no measure."

Name: Fiery Ghoul's Gravestaff
Description: "A fiery death is among the worst ways to perish."

Name: Firebound Spellstaff
Description: "Master the art of pyromancy and the whole world can be yours."

Name: Fire Crystal Spell Staff
Description: "The blazing hot crystal at the edge of the staff radiates pure chaotic energy."

Name: Firefrost
Description: "This staff is an anomaly, a permanently burning piece of ice. Impressive."

Name: Fire Lord's Staff
Description: "Formerly wielded by the strongest pyromancer in recorded history. He nearly conquered the entire world before a brave young hero stopped him."

Name: Fire of Darkness
Description: "There is but one light in the cruel darkness; my staff."

Name: Fires of Retaliation
Description: "An eye for an eye makes the whole world burn."

Name: Fire Staff of the Eternal Watcher
Description: "My flame burns forever. My watch is eternal."

Name: Fire Staff of the Frozen Guardian
Description: "It is difficult to keep warm in such a frigid place, and yet I try."

Name: Flamebound Spellstaff
Description: "You belong to the eternal flame."

Name: Flamebreath
Description: "Put down your staff and let the dragon breath."

Name: Flame of Hephaestus
Description: "With these flames I shall forge a new order, more pure and just."

Name: Flame of the Corrupted Keeper
Description: "He guarded the fires of corruption for eons before his undoing."

Name: Flames of the Breach
Description: "The fringes of the void lick forth from the portal and burn those who dare to enter."

Name: Flamesworn Great Staff
Description: "A hulking staff of the flamesworn mages."

Name: Forest Fire
Description: "Let loose the spark that will engulf the forest."

Name: Forgelighter
Description: "Light the forges and build the weapons. Our assault begins at dawn."

Name: Forgotten Flame
Description: “The flame atop the staff has been burning for ages, a long forgotten remnant of some powerful mage.”

Name: Fuel to the Fire
Description: "Stoke the flames and watch as the fire grows larger than you can imagine."

Name: Great Staff of the Royal Torturer
Description: "You do not wish to talk? Perhaps a little burn will change your mind."

Name: Heretic
Description: "They tell us sorcery is evil. Why then, do they use it against us?"

Name: Ignition
Description: "Light the world aflame."

Name: Lavabinder
Description: "Controlling the molten earth is no easy task, but the power it grants is immense."

Name: Meteoric Decimation
Description: "When you see meteors headed your way... run."

Name: Obsidian Tipped Fire Staff
Description: "The staff is attuned to the magma after being forged in the depths of a volcano."

Name: Overcooked Fire Staff
Description: "This staff was left in the flames a bit too long when it was being forged."

Name: Overheat
Description: "Do not stand in the fire too long."

Name: Pyromaniac
Description: "A fire here, a little more fire there. Fire everywhere!"

Name: Scorched Earth
Description: "Nothing but dust shall remain when I am done here."

Name: Scorn
Description: "My disdain for them is matched only by my desire to wipe them from this place."

Name: Signum Phalarae
Description: "A beacon of honor shining from earlier times."

Name: Singed Flesh
Description: "This weapon smells... bad."

Name: Singe of Corruption
Description: "Corruption burns as if it were a flame."

Name: Siren's Legato
Description: "Smoothly it builds up in a blazing crescendo."

Name: Skeletal Staff of Torment
Description: "Constructed of charred bones and reinforced steel, this grotesque staff has been the cause of quite a few horrors."

Name: Spectral Fire Staff
Description: "This ghastly staff is covered by eternal ethereal flame that does not burn you."

Name: Spellshower Shortstaff
Description: "Rain fire upon your enemies and bask in their destruction."

Name: Spellstaff of Hellfire
Description: "My fury shall be unleashed upon you a thousand times over."

Name: Spellstaff of Heroic Sacrifice
Description: "Her fiery sacrifice saved countless lives. Aeternum is better off because of her."

Name: Spellstaff of the Blue Flame
Description: "It is believed that the blue flame was an ancient organization of powerful mages. What befell them is as of yet, unknown."

Name: Staff of Fiery Torment
Description: "The fires of hell burn hot and long."

Name: Staff of Greater Tribulation
Description: "Unto every life there are trials that must occur. This staff makes them happen more often."

Name: Staff of Ignited Conflict
Description: "A single small spark can start the greatest of wars."

Name: Staff of the Charred Forest
Description: "This staff is carved from the burnt husk of an oak tree, with sigils adorning every part of the shaft."

Name: Staff of the Firesworn
Description: "Give yourself to the flame and know power eternal."

Name: Staff of the Flaming Depths
Description: "Look below us. All that you see is aflame."

Name: Staff of the Lost Ember
Description: "The ember drifts away from the flame."

Name: Taiying's Rage
Description: “She cursed his name. Wu would burn, and his stolen empire with him.”

Name: Transmutation
Description: "Be changed from flesh to ash."

Name: Void Tinged Fire Staff
Description: "The mix of void energies and chaotic fire create a powerful weapon."

Name: Wildfire Torch
Description: "Rampaging and uncontrolled, the wildfire burns all who dare get near."

Name: Wrath of the Wicked Sorcerer
Description: "Scored and rejected by his peers, the young mage was set to become the most powerful pyromancer that ever lived."

Name: Zealot's Refrain
Description: "Why should I relent? They are yet to see the edges of their wickedness."

Name: Fire Prod
Description: “I get that you’d have to make it a bit stronger to prod a bear, but considering this was in her belly it seems like they went too far...”

Name: Anubian War Staff
Description: Blessed with the blistering warmth of the Celestial Body.

Name: Pyrophoros
Description: That which is found between places. By Her many names, we call. The ending of the prayer is Pyrophoros.

Name: Guiding Flame
Description: The light that shines the route to safety.

Name: Bolt of Flame
Description: Like a bolt from the sky you strike your foes.

Name: Chandra's Firebolt
Description: There's more than one way to keep warm.

Name: Primus Pyre
Description: The first flame burns brightest.

Name: Eternal Flame of Osiris
Description: We light the way for those who are lost, immortal, yet destitute of spirit beyond compare.

Name: Bad Medicine
Description: "This is going to hurt, but I promise it will help."

Name: Shaman Initiate's Staff
Description: "Master shamans spend years in training, going through several staves as they perfect their craft."

Name: Winter's Thaw
Description: "As the world awakens from slumber, new life if released."

Name: Arcane Infused Life Staff
Description: "Arcane magic is... unusual for these sorts of spells, but I suppose it can work."

Name: Dark Mending
Description: "Let my power heal your wounds and taint your heart."

Name: Dying Light
Description: “The light went out in his eyes as I tried to bring him back.”

Name: Earth Imbued Staff
Description: "Let nature into your heart and it shall heal your wounds."

Name: Flames of Rebirth
Description: "Be born anew in my fire!"

Name: Fleshbinder
Description: "Siphon the spirit and leave the body behind."

Name: Frozen Life
Description: "Thousands of years trapped beneath the ice, and yet life still simmers within you."

Name: Glowing Life Staff
Description: "The staff glows when nearby corruption."

Name: Immutable Wish
Description: "What if, just this once, we lifted each other instead of ourselves?"

Name: Lifegiving Waters
Description: "Let the waters rush over you and calm your spirit."

Name: Mended Wounds
Description: "You are whole again."

Name: Peaceful Dream
Description: "Sleep, my sweet ones. Tomorrow you shall rise again."

Name: Shattered Life
Description: "No matter how broken you are, you can be pieced back together."

Name: Ship Medic's Staff
Description: "Crossing the ocean is a daunting task even with the finest crew. Keep a well trained medic on board for the injuries you are sure to sustain."

Name: Song of the Crystals
Description: "The crystals in the staff hum and sing a song that soothes your heart."

Name: Staff of Ancient Wonders
Description: "For all their marvelous creations, the magic artifacts left by the Ancients are among the most splendid objects to be found in Aeternum."

Name: Staff of Splendor
Description: "Gaze upon the wonders I create."

Name: Staff of the Court Mage
Description: "Fit for royalty, this staff belonged to several generations of court sorcerers."

Name: Growing Season
Description: "There is a season for everything. A seasons for growing crops. And one for growing vendettas."

Name: Cold Forged Advantage
Description: "Not everything is forged in heat. Some strength comes from the cold."

Name: Cold Forged Advantage
Description: "Not everything is forged in heat. Some strength comes from the cold."

Name: Chained Darkness
Description: "Keep the darkness at bay."

Name: Stormlight
Description: "A beacon in a storm, to guide those ill to health again."

Name: Gaia's Whim
Description: "Her desires flow like rivers, ever changing and unknowable."

Name: Corrupted Life Staff
Description: "Corruption overpowers the holy magic of this staff."

Name: Marshlight
Description: "Unlike the lights that dance over the marshes, this staff will never lead you astray."

Name: Enchanted Life Staff
Description: "Blessed by the wilds which you must save."

Name: Blessings of Balanos
Description: "The great shaman Balanos guarded the sanctuary of Bronzegrove for eons, creating life and healing the wilds of Brightwood."

Name: Bane of Impurity
Description: "Impurities melt away when faced with the harsh light of this staff."

Name: Briarwood Staff
Description: "Gnarled briars were grown to form a strong staff brimming with life."

Name: Soulcage
Description: "How many souls are trapped within this staff? Too many to count."

Name: Staff of Silent Whispers
Description: "Do you hear them? The whispers all around us?"

Name: Stasis
Description: "Be still and let your body heal."

Name: Heirloom Life Staff
Description: "Passed down from generation to generation. Who shall you give this weapon to next?"

Name: Abomination's Staff
Description: This staff hums in your hands menacingly, as though it is unwilling to perform the task at hand.

Name: Dark Angel
Description: "The fallen angel was cast out of the heavens and twisted into a servant of corruption."

Name: Davey Jones's Staff
Description: "We are all reborn in the depths of the sea."

Name: Fragile Protection
Description: "My blessing will protect you. For now."

Name: Fragment of Light
Description: "Even the smallest candle melts away darkness."

Name: Harbinger of Dusk
Description: "Dusk comes and with it, a great evil."

Name: Light of Truth
Description: "Even on the darkest day, the truth will light the way."

Name: Simple Staff of Great Power
Description: "Simple and elegant, this small piece of wood holds untold powers."

Name: Sleek Starmetal Staff
Description: "Fashionable and efficient. The Aeternian way."

Name: Stalagmite Staff
Description: "This weapon appears to be a rock ripped from a cavern and blessed with holy magic."

Name: Starlight
Description: "The stars shine brightest when there is good being done."

Name: Storm Smite
Description: "You dare insult me? You shall feel the power of the storm."

Name: Undeath
Description: "Death is not the end."

Name: Unholy Life
Description: "Twisted magic raised you into undeath. Perhaps I can cleanse you?"

Name: Vineweaver
Description: "Vines seem to grow wherever this staff moves."

Name: Heaven's Light
Description: "Cold and pure, like a clear sky's sunshine after a fresh snow."

Name: Toothed Grin
Description: "A prelude to a more pointed conversation to come."

Name: Dewfrost
Description: "The staff glistens in the morning light as rays of light reflect off the fine metal."

Name: Earths' Essence
Description: "A gift from a Dryad earth warden, this staff is imbued with the essence of a thousand dryad spirits."

Name: Staff of Unholy Rebirth
Description: "I raise you into eternal servitude."

Name: Vital Essence
Description: "This staff smells like the first warmth of spring after a long winter, when all the flowers bloom at once."

Name: Hope Manifest
Description: To manifest light amidst darkness is to first endure darkness without light.

Name: Whims of the Woods
Description: "Whichever way the winds blow, I shall follow."

Name: Devout Worry
Description: "No matter your faith, let your concern for others show them who you truly are."

Name: Staff of Rapid Death
Description: "Your soul shall be mine to wield."

Name: Stolen Soul
Description: "A soul rattles around inside the staff, begging for freedom. In quiet times you hear its screams."

Name: Balance of Life
Description: "Life and death are but two sides of the same coin."

Name: Earth Rejuvenated
Description: "After the slumber of winter, the world awakes refreshed, as life springs forth anew."

Name: Grasping Light
Description: "We reach deep within ourselves in an attempt to understand, when really we need only look at the impact with have on others to see."

Name: Adjorjan's Ancestral Life Staff
Description: "This staff was with Adjorjan for millenia. The wonders and horrors it has seen seem unimaginable."

Name: Arcane Light
Description: "A purple light radiates from the staff, giving you a warm feeling as you wield it."

Name: Breach Battered Life Staff
Description: "Bruised and broken from several trips through the breaches, this staff has saved more lives than you can count."

Name: Curator's Life Staff
Description: "All life is mine to protect."

Name: Decay
Description: "When I have siphoned the soul from your body you shall be a feast for the worms."

Name: Depleted Ritual Staff
Description: "Nearly all of the azoth has been drained from this once powerful staff. What remains is enough for a spell or two."

Name: Essence of Hope
Description: "So long as my staff lights the way our hope shall remain."

Name: Essence of Clarity
Description: "Find the part of you that knows what good is. Nurture it and it will grow."

Name: Flowing Life
Description: "My magic shall flow through you."

Name: Grim Tidings
Description: "I come bearing bad news."

Name: Might of the Elder Shaman
Description: "The shamans of Edengrove wield power that most mortals could only dream of."

Name: Siren's Life Staff
Description: "Sirens are strange creatures. They sing songs of death, yet wield a staff of life?"

Name: Staff of Mourning
Description: "You may mourn for me, and then you shall avenge me."

Name: Staff of the Corrupted Arbiter
Description: "My decision is clear. All shall serve the will of the Tempest."

Name: Staff of the Raging Core
Description: "A fire rages within you. Do not let it burn too hot, lest it consume all that you are."

Name: Staff of the Wood Warden
Description: "Travel the wilds and heal that which is ailing."

Name: Stormcaller
Description: "I call upon the elements to strike down my enemy!"

Name: Timebinding Staff
Description: "Your life is tethered to this place."

Name: Valiant Prayer
Description: "Let your desire to do what is right and good never sway."

Name: Virtue
Description: "She stands as a testament to others."

Name: Traveller's Life
Description: "May the power of the healer always be your true north."

Name: Windsinger
Description: "The chanting grew, rising over the mountaintops and descending upon those less fortunate. Then, I awoke from my dream."

Name: Blessed Wildwood Life Staff
Description: "Take the blessing of the wilds upon you as you venture forth, and let this staff serve both as a protector and a guide."

Name: Echo of Grace
Description: "Walk in my footsteps, and I will show you my mistakes."

Name: Gortan's Tainted Staff
Description: "Corruption has recently set in on the staff as its former master succumbed just days ago."

Name: Aeternum's Rebirth
Description: "This world shall be born again, better and stronger."

Name: Archmage Fultis's Life Staff
Description: "The initials 'A.B.F.' are carved into the staff."

Name: Ascension
Description: "Rise up and meet your challenge."

Name: Baptism
Description: "Wash away your faults and be reborn."

Name: Calm of Cael
Description: "The great shaman Cael maintained such a calm even in the midst of battle that he was able to defeat nearly all who sought to do him harm."

Name: Conqueror's Mercy
Description: "Know when to show strength, but also know when to show restraint."

Name: Courtier's Crescent Staff
Description: "My wisdom will lead this kingdom to greatness, my liege."

Name: Curious Bewitched Staff
Description: "When gripping this staff you feel a compulsion to do heinous acts, ideas which are not your own."

Name: Dark Blessings
Description: "May the Tempest watch over you."

Name: Edengrove's Hope
Description: "Stand with nature and defend her. For she is pure of heart and gives hope to all around her."

Name: Edentide
Description: "The waters of Reekwater seem to react to the staff as it passes near them. Curious."

Name: Faedragon's Life Staff
Description: "The feather of a faedragon is attached to the base of this staff. Ancient legends say that their feathers bring blessings to those who posses them."

Name: Fiery Sermon
Description: "Fire and brimstone shall be yours should you foolishly choose to join the Tempest!"

Name: Fleshwoven Staff
Description: "Seams of human flesh crudely stitched together adorn the shaft of this staff. Disgusting."

Name: Formation of the Storm
Description: "I urge you not to anger me lest you awake a power you do not understand."

Name: Frozen Spellstaff
Description: "The end of the staff appears as if it is magic manifested into a physical form that is frozen solid."

Name: Giver's Green Gift
Description: "Grown using techniques now forgotten, this staff thrums with vitality."

Name: Greatstaff of Storm's Might
Description: "We cannot hope to control the storm's power, only channel it for a short time."

Name: Greatstaff of the Light's Judgement
Description: "Step into the light and be judged."

Name: Heart of Corruption
Description: "I may die, but corruption lives on."

Name: Hidden Depths
Description: "Beneath what seems obvious are hidden depths, waiting to be revealed."

Name: Highborne's Staff
Description: "This weapon is fit for a nobleman, what is a commoner such as yourself doing with it?"

Name: Hope
Description: "Do not fear, hope is no illusion. I hold it in my hand."

Name: Immaculate Life Staff
Description: "That you have survived in this land as long as you have is nothing short of a miracle."

Name: Invader's Unholy Staff
Description: "These lands shall be consecrated in the name of the High Priest."

Name: Lifebinder
Description: "So long as I may walk this earth, you shall live."

Name: Living Crystal Life Staff
Description: "Nature reacts to the crystal in the staff, seemingly growing stronger when it is near."

Name: Malevolence's Will
Description: "The temple seeks the purification of Edengrove. You must see it done."

Name: Miscalculations
Description: "Good intentions sometimes lead to undesired outcomes."

Name: Newfound Longing
Description: "What would the world think of this power? To them, we are as gods now."

Name: Nightwatcher's Staff
Description: "The warm glow of the staff serves to comfort you in the darkest of places."

Name: Open Hand
Description: "When others come to you, offer them protection and relief with what power you have."

Name: Oseguera's Disciple
Description: "High Priest Oseguera recruited and trained hundreds of priests through his years of service. Each disciple was equipped with a staff uniquely crafted to their talents."

Name: Permafrost Life Staff
Description: "The cold does not always need to cause death. It can also preserve life and keep us safe."

Name: Righteous Blessings
Description: "Blessings upon you friend!"

Name: Rime Covered Life Staff
Description: "Icey tendrils extend out from the end of the staff."

Name: Salvation
Description: "Bend the arcane to your will, and you will find even death eludes you. Whether that is a blessing or a curse, I do not know."

Name: Song of Sorrow
Description: "What joy is there in this world?"

Name: Soul Crystal Life Staff
Description: "Some poor soul was siphoned from her body and trapped in this staff, yearning for release."

Name: Soulwarden's Life Staff
Description: "With this weapon you must stand against darkness lest it consume us all."

Name: Spriggan's Heart
Description: "You sense the spirit of the spriggan lying dormant within the staff."

Name: Staff of Blighted Horrors
Description: "The fiends spread their vile blight everywhere they go. Even this weapon is covered in the disease."

Name: Staff of Cavernous Horrors
Description: "Do not delve into the caverns for you do not know what horrors await you."

Name: Staff of Lightning's Might
Description: "Let your enemies feel your magic like a bolt of lightning jolting through their body."

Name: Staff of Peerless Whispers
Description: "Succumb to the void and let yourself be free."

Name: Staff of Pragmatic Justice
Description: "Justice is not often this black and white."

Name: Staff of Righteous Retribution
Description: "People get what is coming to them."

Name: Staff of Silent Mending
Description: "Be still my child as I tend to your wounds."

Name: Staff of Sorrows
Description: "A grave sadness overtakes you as you wield this staff, along with a sense of duty to set right the injustices that you find."

Name: Staff of the Cleansing Waters
Description: "Submerse yourself and let out your breath. When my waters fill your lungs, you shall be pure."

Name: Staff of the Dark Prophet
Description: "The dark prophet traveled aeternum spreading tales of the power of corruption, enticing weak souls to join his cause."

Name: Staff of the Endless Abyss
Description: "Peer into the abyss and see that which has no end."

Name: Staff of the First Sin
Description: "You dishonor all mankind with what you have done."

Name: Staff of the Hellsworn Priest
Description: "What little life you have left I shall rip from your body as I throw you into the fires below."

Name: Staff of the Heretic
Description: "Doom! Death! Destruction! It is here!"

Name: Staff of the Reawakener
Description: "Come, your slumber must end. We have work to do."

Name: Staff of the Voidmaker
Description: "With this weapon I shall unmake you."

Name: Stormwhisper
Description: "Do you hear it? The eerie silence? The calm before the storm."

Name: Tadeas's Curious Staff
Description: "This staff is a peculiar thing. We have long been tought that Dryads do not get attached to physical objects, and yet this staff clearly was of some value to Tadeas."

Name: Taiying's Hope
Description: "When the Empress was first exiled to this land, this staff was her foremost weapon. It's clear it was discarded long ago."

Name: Tempest Forged Staff
Description: "She ordered this staff built for one of her most loyal disciples. The craftstmanship is clearly that of the corrupted."

Name: The Grotto's Seed
Description: "A single seed can grow a mighty forest."

Name: Unholy Matrimony
Description: "There is nothing sacred about this love."

Name: Unspoken Desire
Description: "Even when speaking in hushed tones, we do not speak of this."

Name: Warmage's Life Staff
Description: "What war has ever been won without a great healer?"

Name: Muster
Description: “Crush their walls! Destroy their fortifications! March forward to demolish their will!”

Name: Lifespring
Description: “Mother Nature’s protection flows as endlessly as her love.”

Name: Fallen Branch
Description: What was once a life giver now only brings suffering.

Name: Tide of Moonlight
Description: Moonlight washes over the landscape and takes with it the sins of an old day.

Name: Branch of Sepes
Description: "The twig still hums with a vibrant azoth aura."

Name: Reeds of Spontanea
Description: Ever blossoming, ever vibrant, ever radiant as the mercurial shimmer of false hope.

Name: Eye of Ra
Description: "None above or below can hope to behold the might of the Sun and live."

Name: Petra Ataraxia
Description: "Judgment and protection for all."

Name: Liver of Prometheus
Description: Stealing fire from the gods went ill for Prometheus...but why not try your luck?

Name: Mary's Last Warning
Description: "When Mary takes out her shield, you know she has no patience left."

Name: Vexing Obstruction
Description: "It is always useful to have the protection of a higher power when heading into battle."

Name: Determination
Description: "The first thing to understand about your enemy is that their will is as strong as yours."

Name: Quiescense
Description: "Only when you are truly at peace will see what you have wrought."

Name: Umbra
Description: "Stand in my shadow and know that I will provide."

Name: Ceremonial Defenses
Description: "These Ceremonial Defenses provide far more than just a show of protection."

Name: Ceremonial Defenses
Description: "These Ceremonial Defenses provide far more than just a show of protection."

Name: Dead Silence
Description: "Sometimes the best shield is to not say anything at all."

Name: Dominant Discourse
Description: "When this shield is in use, it is hard to get a cutting word in edgewise."

Name: Presumptive Action
Description: "It is better to be prepared for attack, then to stand back and assume you will never come to harm."

Name: Nature's Shield
Description: "To protect the sleeping land, steep mountains sprang forth, covered in thorny brambles, halting their path forward."

Name: Insatiable Void
Description: "Nothing stops a weapon as fast as getting stuck in an insatiable void."

Name: The Wall
Description: "I am a wall. I stop those in front of me and protect those behind me. Without me, this great nation will fall."

Name: Ulfar's Determination
Description: Ulfar's nigh-impentrable Kite Shield.

Name: Steinvirki
Description: A veritable wall of stone.

Name: Denier's Wall
Description: "It was long believed that no one could breach Denier's Wall once it was in place."

Name: Best Friend
Description: "Patricia always said her best friend would never leave her side."

Name: Spearturner's Shield
Description: "A well-made shield can turn aside the strongest of spears."

Name: Aegis Vitrioulsor
Description: "It is said it took three months, and the destruction of four forges, to create this shield."

Name: Eden's Kiss
Description: "A gift of the garden to protect against those who would slip past your guard."

Name: Legatus General's Buckler
Description: "This buckler has been through hell and back, surviving the worst of what was up against thrown at the Legatus General."

Name: Bastion
Description: "Get behind me! Let them crash against us as waves against the rocks."

Name: Hawkfall
Description: "You only ever hear it in the distance, but that's the sound of a small thing dying."

Name: Servitude
Description: "Raise this proudly in service of your commander, for she will not forget your heroism this day."

Name: Duty Bound
Description: "We are bound by a vow. We will not break."

Name: Shield of Suppresion
Description: "Tis impressive how opressive the suppresion is!"

Name: Gilded Defense
Description: "A shield so beautiful it's a shame its purpose is to become scratched and battered."

Name: Compulsion
Description: "I cannot step away, I cannot turn my gaze. I will stand until I can stand no longer."

Name: Everlasting Shade
Description: "Fear not, my guard is as wide as the boughs of the mighty oak."

Name: Refuge
Description: "Your place is beneath the shadow of my guard."

Name: Tolerant Hound
Description: "Use measure in training. Too much and things become dull. Not enough and well, there goes your hand."

Name: With No Other
Description: "Stand with me. Know that I will stand with you."

Name: Motherwell Wisher's Coin
Description: "One coin for luck, two for prosperity, three for joy. You only have one, so hopefully all you need is luck."

Name: Oath of the Pacifist
Description: "No harm shall be done today. Not to you, and not to me."

Name: Siren's Glissando
Description: "Continuously deflicting attacks, as a sleek counterpoint to your opponent's rage."

Name: Stability of the Mountain
Description: "For the mountain does not fall, it stands firm through endless time."

Name: Tempered Disruption
Description: "A well-timed disruption was all it took to disengage from the battle."

Name: Unrelenting Mercy
Description: "This is the type of mercy you do not hope to receive, for in many ways it is worse than being reviled."

Name: Weary Traveler
Description: "At last, he arrived."

Name: Immutable Resolve
Description: "With the will of a legion we shield the frail."

Name: Divinus
Description: It is believed that this holy shield, imbued with the divine light of the Spark, descended from the heavens to help the Covenant defend their homeland.

Name: Hourglass
Description: "Turning this shield upside down has no effect... we tried."

Name: Door of Night
Description: Nothing gets into the House of the Night.

Name: Titanwall
Description: Foes will part like wheat before this shield.

Name: Headbutt
Description: "Meh-eh-eh-eh-eh"

Name: Girdle of Geb
Description: "Forged in the Cradle of Nu, where the mountains roam like lions."

Name: Shield of the Montukahl
Description: "As fast as the falcon, as quick as the snake."

Name: Maat's Scale
Description: Place your heart on the brass plate, and eternity shall be your reward.

Name: Aegis of the Father
Description: Those who are of the gods are protected by the gods. Though apparently, not well enough.

Name: Persistent Growth
Description: "The smallest sapling may crush the mightest fort, with time."

Name: Earthen Smasher
Description: “You laugh, but I just saw a dryad use this 'rock on a stick' to smash our scout into the ground.”

Name: Demise of the Depths
Description: "The deep places of the world play host to foul and wicked creatures, beings who must be purged from Aeternum.

Name: Arcane Cracker
Description: “Knowledge has no bounds, why should you?”

Name: Bloodied Crusher
Description: "The heat of battle is a grim place. Sometimes it's difficult to separate friend from foe."

Name: Bonecrusher
Description: "Ironically, this deadly Ancient weapon was designed for shattering opponents' bones."

Name: Broken Glass
Description: "Glass shatters into the skin of your enemy as your hammer crushes their bones."

Name: Eager Steel
Description: "Out of the furnace, into the fight."

Name: Earthshaker
Description: "This will teach you how the mighty fall."

Name: False Hope
Description: "Even in the darkest deception, lies some small truth."

Name: Forceful Rebuke
Description: "She spat the words at him as though they tasted bad."

Name: Ghastly Gavel
Description: "Guilty."

Name: Guard Captain's Maul
Description: "Keeping the peasants away from royalty is not easy work."

Name: Heart Beat
Description: "The first and last thing you'll hear in life."

Name: Iced Crusher
Description: "Smashing your way through the tundra is an effective way to travel."

Name: Mischievous Hare
Description: "Walking through the forest and bopping them on the head."

Name: Nimbusight
Description: "The winds are picking up. Head for shore and don't look back."

Name: Pristine Dawn
Description: "May she light your way, when all you see is darkness."

Name: Serrated Maul
Description: "For when you need to tenderize and tear."

Name: Wavesmasher
Description: "Do not let the waves break you."

Name: Weighted Maul
Description: "Remember to swing with your legs."

Name: Crystalline Crusher
Description: "Jagged crystals jut out from all sides of the hammer."

Name: The Flattener
Description: "Originally used to work the metal in Ezra's forges, this hammer lives up to its name."

Name: The Flattener
Description: "Originally used to work the metal in Ezra's forges, this hammer lives up to its name."

Name: Flárádr Mjölnir
Description: "When lightning strikes twice, you can bet Flárádr Mjölnir is near."

Name: Cryptbreaker
Description: "With this in hammer, there was no crypt that could keep Goura locked inside."

Name: Defender of Darkness
Description: "Battling the demons that lept forth from the portal, the warrior swung her hammer as mightily as she could. And yet for every demon she killed, three more came forth."

Name: The Tenderizer
Description: "Just as effective on enemies as it is on meat."

Name: Force of Nature
Description: "Just like Fungalstep, this War Hammer is a force unto itself."

Name: Judgement of Ra
Description: "Ra looked down upon the world and found it needed to be cleansed to start anew."

Name: Abyssal Conqueror
Description: “The fringes of the void are ever expanding. Without brave adventurers to fight back, this world would be lost."

Name: Anesthetic
Description: "Just a quick tap on your skull and you'll be out cold."

Name: Consecrated War Hammer
Description: "Formerly carried by a warrior who would rather wander the land and preach in the name of the Convenant instead of wield his hammer in battle. It seems one traveler didn't like this message and took it upon themselves to rid the warrior of his hammer."

Name: Corrupted Culler
Description: "Succumb to the whispers of the void. Let go of your worldly tethers."

Name: Corrupted Resistance
Description: “Walk swiftly and carry a big hammer.”

Name: Defeated Hope
Description: "A hope's last gasp is the loudest silence you will ever experience."

Name: Enchanted Maul
Description: "Humming with magical energies, this War Hammer was forged in the depths of the Starstone Barrows long ago."

Name: Force of Fire
Description: “Nothing is safe from the flame. It spreads viciously, lighting all in its path ablaze.”

Name: Force of Frost
Description: "The cold conquers all. Fires are extinguished, blood freezes, death comes."

Name: Gale Force
Description: "A strong wind seems to knock your enemy down before the hammer even makes contact."

Name: Galley Cook's Tenderizer
Description: “Preparing meat on the high seas is no easy task as your ship gets tossed about. A bigger hammer makes preparing meals that much easier.”

Name: Glossy Demise
Description: "Dying has never looked so good."

Name: Pixie Pummeler
Description: "Nasty creatures, Pixies are. Winged nuisances that need a good hammer to the back to bring them down."

Name: Restless Sanctity
Description: "We think we can speak of sacred things as though they are not, and we will pay dearly for it."

Name: Roots of Pain
Description: "A gnarled mess of roots, vines, and twigs, this vicious hammer is something you do not want to be struck by."

Name: War Hammer of the Last Ones
Description: "Forged of a soft glowing wood, this hammer is covered in runes you have never seen before."

Name: Warmonger
Description: "We scream and howl about peace, but in truth we are merely waiting for the next good fight."

Name: Wild Rage
Description: "None shall stand against me."

Name: Wretched War Hammer
Description: "A foul stench lingers in the air when the hammer is swung."

Name: Halfdan's Reach
Description: Halfdan's mighty hammer. Many a foe have been crushed into dust by its former wielder.

Name: Volundr's Ire
Description: War Hammer that serves as a grim reminder never to cross the blacksmith.

Name: Abominable Maul
Description: "You have not seen the worst of what the deeppits offer until you have seen the destruction done by a Deeppit Abomination."

Name: Nature's Justice
Description: "Nature cares not for your intentions, only for your results."

Name: Skullworm Separator
Description: "Sometimes the best way to get rid of skullworms is to get rid of everything between your ears."

Name: Hammer of Forgotten Dreams
Description: "Trying to remember a fleeting dream is like trying to catch a piece of paper in a hurricane."

Name: Scurvyclonk
Description: "Scurvyhook was not known for being subtle with weapon names. When asked, they said this was the sound it made when hitting their foes."

Name: Crushing Blow
Description: "A single hit will reduce stone to rubble, and your enemies to past regrets."

Name: Musselcracker
Description: "Cracking open shells has never been easier. Though you have to be careful if you want anything inside to still be intact."

Name: Boneshatter Animus
Description: "Hostility radiates out from this weapon like rays of light from the sun. Even to hold it to is be infected by anger."

Name: Hammer of the Haunted Hill
Description: "The hill just outside of town was full of graves that had been recently disturbed as their former denizens arose from a long slumber."

Name: Serendipity
Description: "What god of fate caused us to meet here and now, on this battlefield?"

Name: Tempest's Swing
Description: "None can withstand the battering of my hammer."

Name: Rootgrip
Description: “The vines that twist around the handle of this war hammer seem to have been grown by some long forgotten magic.”

Name: Shattered Hope
Description: "As a rock shatters a window, so does this hammer shatter the hopes of your enemies."

Name: Ancient Struggle
Description: "The conflict between corruption and azoth has lasted for centuries. Surely the bloodshed shall continue for centuries to come."

Name: Artistry
Description: "The world is but a canvas. This war hammer is my brush, and your blood is my paint."

Name: A Trick of the Mind
Description: "Watch more closely now, for if you blink, you will miss it."

Name: Balance of Power
Description: "If the scale tips too far either way, the entire world is in jeopardy."

Name: Blightbane War Hammer
Description: "The Angry Earth have a host of enemies, but blight is their most consistent struggle."

Name: Breachcrusher
Description: "Why carry an Azoth Staff when a hammer is just as effective?"

Name: Buccaneer's Blunt Edge
Description: "Anyone who says a sword is the most effective weapon has never tried to storm a keep."

Name: Cannibal's Hammer
Description: "A doctor was found to have eaten many of his patients, first knocking them out with his hammer before feasting on their corpses."

Name: Cleaveguard
Description: “While corrupted forces constantly venture south, maintaining their stronghold in the Great Cleave is of the utmost importance to them.”

Name: Forgotten Experiment
Description: "Of the many experiments left beind by the Ancients, this War Hammer is one of the more peculiar ones. The hammer vibrates at all times, humming some strange song."

Name: Guardian's War Hammer
Description: "The Ancient Guardians weapons are a fascinating study of the craftsmanship left behind by the Ancients."

Name: Hammer of the Corrupted Champion
Description: "The corrupted have their heroes too."

Name: Hellsmasher
Description: "I will travel through the seven circles of hell so long as it means defeating you."

Name: Keepbreaker
Description: "All gates give way beneath my might."

Name: Lightning's Fist
Description: "Sparks fly as the war hammer hits armor."

Name: Nature's Wrath
Description: "The wilds have a way of defending themselves when danger is present."

Name: Prideful Misstep
Description: "Everyone watched as he walked unknowingly into his own demise."

Name: Prismatic Maul
Description: "Thousands of colors shine forth from the hammer. Even in the dark, the war hammer lights your way."

Name: Restless Night
Description: "Days in Brightwood are fine enough. But as the sun sets below the horizon, the gasps and groans of the ghouls just outside of town become louder and louder, striking fear into the heart of all who attempt to call the cursed forest home."

Name: Sea of Doubt
Description: "What you are capable of will surprise you. Doubt not. Swing true."

Name: Siegebreaker
Description: "Three swings of my hammer and your gates shall fall."

Name: Spellbound Gaze
Description: "He stared at her, beautiful in her bloodied armor, as she laid waste to his enemies."

Name: War Hammer of the Unmaking
Description: "Life brings us together, the void rips us apart."

Name: Will of the Enraged
Description: "It puffs us up, makes us feel big, makes us feel invincible. In truth, it is all posturing until the first hammer falls."

Name: Malice Mallet
Description: "The shadow in his peripheral vision was the last thing he saw before he ate the dirt."

Name: Graiths Maul
Description: "Once owned by a brutish man who rarely left his cave. Known for throwing his live victims off the nearby cliff."

Name: Yul'kithir
Description: "Demonic transcriptions cover the handle of the war hammer."

Name: Adiana's Adjudicator
Description: "The angry earth is an uncontrollable force driven by one question. Will you harm the earth or make it whole?"

Name: Ancient Promise
Description: "Stand ready, for the demons do not tarry."

Name: Arcane War Hammer
Description: "A hammer of pure magical energy, the weapon weighs nothing yet hits with the force of an avalanche."

Name: Artificial Life
Description: "For a short time a tentative peace stood across Aeternum. It lasted meer days."

Name: Battered Wave
Description: "The waves were painted a horrific red after the two ships crashed into battle."

Name: Battering Ram
Description: "Each swing breaks the hammer more and more."

Name: Bloodfeud
Description: "The hate between the two families went so far back that no one alive even remembered why they hated the others."

Name: Bloody Rudder
Description: "Steer your ship or steer your vengeance."

Name: Brutal Smasher
Description: "Have you ever hit someone in the head with a war hammer? No? Well imagine a smashed pumpkin."

Name: Burning Rage
Description: "The fires of hatred consumed her heart, and the whole world felt her fury."

Name: Corpse Bride's Command
Description: "The corpse bride ordered her servants to go forth and carry out her judgement on those she deemed unfaithful."

Name: Corrupted Core
Description: "The heart of the war hammer is a sphere of corrupted energy. It pulses as its tendrils grasp the edges of the grip, reaching into the heart of whoever wields the weapon."

Name: Courtly War Hammer
Description: "More fitting to be stowed in a throne room than be used in battle."

Name: Cycle of Life
Description: "We are born. We live. You die."

Name: Darkseer's Maul
Description: "The Corrupted darkseer wielded this hammer for a generation, reaving death and darkness upon all who might cross her path."

Name: Demon's Bane
Description: "Whatever comes from the corrupted portals shall be met with a quick swing of my hammer."

Name: Dreamcrusher
Description: "The only thing more certain than time itself is the failure of mankind to rise above its own self interest."

Name: Duskbringer
Description: "Lights out."

Name: Earthbinder Ward
Description: "In all things there are cycles. The Earthbinder Ward helps break them."

Name: Enchanted Crystal War Hammer
Description: "Magic gems imbued in the head of the hammer add a mystical element to an already formidable weapon."

Name: End of Days
Description: "Don't celebrate yet. This is only the beginning."

Name: Energized War Hammer
Description: "Magic energy of some sort flows through the hammer, rejuvenating those who wield it."

Name: Flaming Brand
Description: "Wear this mark with pride. Let the world know you serve me."

Name: Full Moon
Description: "Blessed be the Night Sky Queen. May she guide the tides of your fate."

Name: Gaea's Revenge
Description: "The earth shook for days without stopping, until everyone forgot what it felt like to be on solid ground."

Name: Glacial Movement
Description: "Slowly crush them under your icy grip."

Name: Gracious Host
Description: "I alone will teach them how unexpected guests should be treated."

Name: Gravekeeper
Description: "Corpses belong in the ground. Once they start rising again, it's time to break out the hammer."

Name: Greenseer's Guide
Description: "The Greenseer saw many futures. This reality was not one of them."

Name: Hammer of Justice
Description: "The Queen's justice must be delivered by any means necessary."

Name: Judgement of Malevolence
Description: "Those judged were found lacking. And so were given what they lacked, often to great excess."

Name: Legacy of the Makers
Description: "Monuments of the power of the Ancients are scattered across Aeternum. Their guardians remain as a testament to what they built, and why they left."

Name: Maul of the Cursed Exile
Description: "Banishment was a death sentence for most. But through a bargain with some dark power, the exile grew in strength and terrorized his former home."

Name: Mirepaw's Fist
Description: "It takes the strength of a bear to wield such a massive weapon. And the cunning of a bear to know when best to use it."

Name: Mjolnir
Description: "Are you worthy?"

Name: Obsidian War Hammer
Description: "Volcanic eruptions provide a narrow window for forging weapons from the molten rock spewing out of the mountain."

Name: Ogre's Headcrusher
Description: "While the Ogres of Aeternum are deadly with just their bare hands, once they have a weapon they are truly a sight to fear."

Name: Parabellum
Description: "War is a funny thing. We do not want it, yet we seek it endlessly."

Name: Persuader
Description: "Will you tell me? Or do you have no need of your other leg?"

Name: PLACE HOLDER Officer X's Burden
Description: “He followed the Siren to the ends of the Earth and back. All it cost was his soul.”

Name: Portalsmasher
Description: "You will know it not only by name, but by taste, smell, and the relief it brings."

Name: Residual Hate
Description: "I cannot shake it. It festers within me, weeping into pools of vendetta."

Name: Restraint
Description: "Strike with intent. Know when it is time and when it is not."

Name: Rolling Thunder
Description: "I know they'll hear me coming. Subtlety is for people who have something to fear."

Name: Sacred Demise
Description: "Death is but a new beginning."

Name: Sacrificial Crusher
Description: "When the cold winds whip at your back, certain sacrifices must be made. Not all who travel to the edges of the world will make it back."

Name: Sacrosanct
Description: "Ancient magic and divine blessings, forged in the fires of vengeance."

Name: Shard of Reality
Description: "We have a tentative grasp on our reality, but what of the others?"

Name: Soulbreaker, Isabella's Power
Description: "Smash the spirit."

Name: Soulforged Blight
Description: "With the final strike, the smith's forging was finished. She held the hammer up, and could hear weeping within the metal."

Name: Spellsworn Maul
Description: "A sect of Ancient Guardian's wielded formidable enchanted hammers as they defended their libraries. Whatever knowledge laid inside those dusty tomes was precious to the Ancients."

Name: Spriggan's Grasp
Description: "For all the effectiveness of a war hammer, being smashed by a spriggan's root is a new type of pain."

Name: Steel to Blood
Description: "Not exactly a science, but it'll do."

Name: Stonerend
Description: "No wall has stood against me, and no wall shall."

Name: Storm's End
Description: "A single crack of lightning is all you shall see as my hammer meets your breastplate."

Name: Surrogate of Justice
Description: "The only justice one can hope to receive in this acursed world is their end."

Name: Taiying's Vengeance
Description: “The Empress gazed upon her shipyard. Everything was exactly as planned. Nothing could stop her now.”

Name: Tendril of Thalum
Description: "The blessed tree was sacred for the Dryads, until misguided explorers ripped its limbs from the earth. This hammer is all that remains."

Name: Terracrash
Description: “The Earth trembled and bowed to his will.”

Name: The Dark Maul
Description: "Red and black glass horns adorn the edge of the weapon."

Name: The Diver's Companion
Description: "Scholars debate whether the Ancient Guardians are truly alive or whether their reanimation constitutes some other state of being."

Name: Shard of Reality
Description: "When the crown falls from the head of the regent, your kingdom will be mine."

Name: Undertow
Description: "Let them grandstand. In the end, you control the flow of battle."

Name: Vinewoven War Hammer
Description: "Forged by a dryad shaman, this hammer is an amalgamation of vines woven into a blunt instrument of death."

Name: Volcano Smasher
Description: "It moves with the speed of lava and the destruction of an eruption."

Name: War Hammer of Dryadic Power
Description: "You who wield this hammer holds the power of all creation."

Name: War Hammer of the Sacred Woods
Description: "For as holy as the woods of the world are, danger lurks around every corner."

Name: Wicked Wish
Description: "Violent thoughts raced in his mind as he teetered on the brink."

Name: Widowmaker
Description: “We shall meet again in the next life.”

Name: Word of Wisdom
Description: "Die."

Name: Wrath of the Sisters
Description: "The Twisted Sisters were a vicious group of bandits who terrorized the roads for years. When they descended upon your caravan, your only choice was to run."

Name: Bear Bone Maul
Description: "Bears have incredibly dense bones, perfect for crafting crude war hammers."

Name: Entertainer's Maul
Description: "Both my hammer and my eyes are up here."

Name: Commitment
Description: "Forged with materials taken from the weapons that belonged to the victorious Syndicate Generals after a great battle for control of Aeternum. The initials of these champions are engraved in the haft - B, S, K, D, L, C, C, T, P, C, D."

Name: Gilded Greed
Description: "All the luck, no strings attached."

Name: Le Foudroyeur
Description: "It is said that lightning struck for two weeks from Monarchs' Bluffs to Mourningdale. When the last bolt struck, this hammer was left behind."

Name: Warrior's Burden
Description: "It's heavy, but still doesn't compare with the blood on your hands."

Name: Gavel of the Gates
Description: The walls between the worlds cannot withstand such strikes.

Name: Breaker of Arta
Description: The earth shattered and shook, breaking apart by the power of the blows.

Name: Batheqet's Cudgel
Description: "Beauteous with a toadlike grace, heartily swung at a bovine pace."

Name: Crag of Nirt
Description: A newborn mountain that is just a little bit lost.

Name: Wallbuilder
Description: Better known by some as "The Wallbreaker".

Name: Mirror
Description: Its reflective qualities are not to be underestimated.

Name: Rushdown
Description: Don't even give them the chance to react.

Name: Rending Slicer
Description: Cut your foes down to a much more manageable size.

Name: Outfighter's Sword
Description: "A properly practiced stance will give you and edge in duels, trainee."

Name: Heart Stake
Description: A strike to the heart is deadly to all, whether it be in love or war.

Name: Potential
Description: An incredible amount of energy can be stored within this sword.

Name: Demon Slayer
Description: This blade was forged to slay more than men.

Name: Exorcist
Description: A holy tool meant for excising lost souls from this world.

Name: Clear Cutter
Description: It is greatly feared by its natural enemy. Dandelions.

Name: Stone And Blood
Description: Empires have always been built with stone and blood.

Name: Zealot's Fury
Description: The righteous anger of such a pious man is dangerous indeed.

Name: Barbarism
Description: Such violent battles may seem barbaric to some. But what use is civility to a dead man?

Name: Vim
Description: You feel your vigor return to you as you wield this blade.

Name: Fear-Wrought
Description: This sword was forged in the fear of its wielders foes.

Name: Iron-Blooded Blade
Description: This was forged as a memorial from a deadly battlefield.

Name: Lightning Rod
Description: Wield the power of the sky.

Name: Growthbane
Description: Not even the smallest of weeds will escape its sight.

Name: Force Of Will
Description: Stand again. Never Falter. Stand tall and proud.

Name: Blood And Bone
Description: Forged in blood and marrow, such a blade carries a heavy weight behind it.

Name: Blow for Blow
Description: At the end of a fight, when arms are flagging and morale is falling. All the can be done is strike, and see who falls first.

Name: Anklebiter
Description: With a blade such as this you'll always be biting at the heels of your prey.

Name: Great Cleave
Description: A monstrous weapon that can leave a monstrous wound.

Name: Lockstep
Description: "Stay in stride with your adversary. Keep watch of their feet to know their future."

Name: As Above, So Below.
Description: "The sky lights our way, we follow the path it sets for us."

Name: Watcher's Greatsword
Description: This blade was taken from a guardian eons ago. It has changed hands many times since.

Name: Footwork
Description: Proper footwork is the first skill any swordman should master.

Name: Clench
Description: "Grit your teeth and bear it, whelp."

Name: Agile Prowess
Description: Your speed should be impressive if you wish to wield this effectively.

Name: Breath Of Life
Description: You breathe life into the trodden dirt around you.

Name: Results
Description: "Results are all that matters."

Name: The Simple Blade
Description: While not a unique masterpiece, many appreciate the skill of the blacksmith for making something so reliable.

Name: Foedrinker
Description: This cursed blade doesn't just drink the blood of its victims like other such 'cursed' weapons.

Name: Sword of the Sire
Description: This ceremonial blade was stolen from a patriarch. He never noticed its departure.

Name: Dastardly Choice
Description: "Simply unfair my good fellow. Have you no respect for you opponent?"

Name: Bait And Punish
Description: "If you can dodge a hammer you can dodge a sword."

Name: Drevin's Blade
Description: This blade was once used to saly a poor soul in the name of a false kingdom.

Name: Azoth Infused Blade
Description: This blade was left in the quenching tank just a smidge too long, and it came it out just a smidge too magical.

Name: Bane of Corruption
Description: Corrupted beings naturally shiver in fear at the sight of this weapon.

Name: Brevity
Description: The pen is mightier than the sword, but this sword is stronger than your weak wit.

Name: Life Knight
Description: Wielders of this blade fight for life to continue against all odds.

Name: Girasol
Description: An opaline beauty.

Name: Heelstrike
Description: Strike low to weaken your prey.

Name: Practiced Blows
Description: This weapon was wielded by many swordmasters through time. Their dedication guides your strikes.

Name: Breath of the Sky
Description: Fill your lungs with the fresh life of the sky.

Name: Tortoise Strike
Description: It may be slow, but don't count it out of the race.

Name: Soulstrike
Description: Pierce their heart to strike deep in their soul.

Name: Ripple
Description: "Like ripples in water, even small mistakes in your form can disrupt you."

Name: Sonic Sword
Description: You feel as if you are becoming a blur while wielding this sword.

Name: Bloodsucker's Sword
Description: It longs to taste the blood of the fallen, and after wielding it, maybe you do too...

Name: Downdraft
Description: The wisdom of the winds will guide your blade.

Name: Defender's Might
Description: "We shall not bend! We shall not fall! Their tide will break against our walls this day!"

Name: Cleansing Enchantment
Description: The blessing of a humble, wandering priest lives on in this sword, long after his death.

Name: Transference
Description: "Let their energy flow through you and become the strength your arm will need."

Name: Supplicium
Description: Cum hunc gladium sustollo, opto ut pauper iste peccator vitam aeternam recipiat.

Name: Rough Edge
Description: A simple blade with a well-weathered edge.

Name: Stonehewer
Description: Cuts through stone like a hot knife through the Angry Earth.

Name: Branch of Deretole
Description: Crafted from the fallen iron branch of a giant tree. Or at least, what the scavenger assumed to be a tree.

Name: Knife of God
Description: How large would you have to be, to consider such a blade to be a knife?

Name: Riverwake
Description: A clean cut through the wave.

Name: Sword of Strength
Description: You feel great strength well up from within you while wielding this blade.

Name: Flint
Description: A weapon built for an adventurer. It doubles as both protection and a simple firestarter due to its construction.

Name: Paladin's Holy Sword
Description: Justis spem ferimus. Ad vitiatum ignem deferimus.

Name: Soulstep
Description: It draws energy from your future to give strength to you now.

Name: Slipstream
Description: You don't feel much faster, but you do seem to be moving through the air with less resistance.

Name: Lifeforce
Description: You feel your pulse up through the blade.

Name: Fleshripper
Description: Demons flee in face of such a terrible blade.

Name: Resilience of Knights
Description: May you have the courage to stand in the face of injustice, and strength to protect the just.

Name: Light Blade
Description: While it may be particularly dense, the lighter construction gives different advantages.

Name: Siegebreaker
Description: Not even thick stone walls can stand before such a destructive blade.

Name: Torrent
Description: "Your strikes must feel as though a downpour has fallen upon your opponents head."

Name: Arcane Step
Description: This once terrible blade was suffused with enough magic energy to level even a great beast. Its power has waned to not even a shred of its former glory.

Name: Spiritpath
Description: Lost wandering souls guided this blade to you in the hopes you will guide them to their next life.

Name: Logan's Blade
Description: Not even his own school would speak of him.

Name: Tough Times
Description: You must stand firm in the face of overwhelming odds. For even a single new day is the greatest shame you can bring to such despicable foes.

Name: Beast Hunter's Blade
Description: This blade is used by trained experts to hunt enormous monsters.

Name: Gutter Rung
Description: This blade was crafted from old scrap metal taken out of a forgotten back-alley.

Name: Sword of the Defender
Description: Stand firm. You shall not allow even a moment's hesitation to pass your ward's face.

Name: Warcry
Description: A great cry bellowed forth as this blade fell out of the sky in front of its wielder.

Name: Heavy Rend
Description: "Aye, they may be better armored, but that'll only matter until I cleave them down."

Name: Sword of the Hermit
Description: A quiet man led a quiet life. Though not for lack of interruptions. Thankfully, most of which were not repeat offenders.

Name: Brimstone
Description: Forged from fire and cast in lava.

Name: Brash Combat
Description: Rush forward and strike them down. To hell with the consequences.

Name: Shockwave
Description: You feel a great deal of energy contained within this blade, and it must go somewhere. And soon.

Name: Barkbite
Description: Coed yr hen a mwsogl amser.

Name: Barbarian's Blade
Description: Mountainous warriors from another land choose to wield such heavy blades as they feel they better conduct their warrior's spirit.

Name: Shivering Stance
Description: This blade is cold it makes you shiver. Which coincidentally has caused more than one foe to miss a vital strike.

Name: Tempo
Description: "A swordfight is all about tempo, lad. Don't your opponent take it from you."

Name: Energy Drain
Description: It seems to be sucking the life from your veins, but thankfully, you aren't its only source of sustenance.

Name: Grip of Truth
Description: There is no magic in this blade, but it's still quite good at wringing the truth out of the sinners.

Name: Dismemberment
Description: "If armor can't even stop such a blade, do you really think you will be any safer?"

Name: Fighter's Blade
Description: A mass-produced blade. It has seen a great deal of use in the Coliseum. But how could such a thing wash up on the shores of Aeternum...?

Name: Warrior's Weapon
Description: A straightforward and reliable choice for many warriors.

Name: Self-Reflection
Description: If you do not know yourself, how will you know anything else?

Name: Willbreaker
Description: Such a terrifying blade is almost better as a tool of intimidation, as opposed to an actual weapon.

Name: Putrefaction
Description: It was used to 'study' many terrible monsters, and eventually it took on some of their traits.

Name: Personal Accountability
Description: "I trust only in myself. Comrades will always betray you."

Name: Fleeting Strike
Description: A swift strike that leaves your foe questioning where you were.

Name: Mediumsword
Description: I mean it’s like, okay I guess.

Name: Flame of Progress
Description: Man marches forth with little regard of stewardship for the life around him.

Name: Rampage
Description: You could swear someone was quietly whispering over your shoulder, telling you to destroy everything around you...

Name: Craftsman's Passion
Description: The passion of its creator shines through.

Name: Corrupted Cratermaker
Description: Forged from a meteorite that felled many living beings eons ago.

Name: Herdmaster's Rod
Description: The sand elementals of Brimstone also take great pride in disciplining their livestock when necessary.

Name: Reflection of Aker
Description: The gatekeeper never abandons his lonely vigil.

Name: Sacred Threshold
Description: Submit to Judgement, or be denied passage.

Name: Horizon Line
Description: Draw a line in the sand, and dare your enemies to cross it.

Name: Jupiter's Judgement
Description: It is unwise to scorn the greatest of the gods.

Name: Dogstar's Tooth
Description: Steel glitters with embedded starlight.

Name: Fleshsticker
Description: "Oww."

Name: Vinecursed Blade
Description: "The vines on the rapier regrow as fast as you can rip them off."

Name: Twig of the Azoth Tree
Description: "Snapped from the Azoth tree and sharpened to a fine point, this weapon pulses with the energy of the angry earth."

Name: Brigand's Blade
Description: "Respect your laws? I would never."

Name: Vicious Rapier
Description: "Your superior swordsmanship is enough to defeat nearly any foe."

Name: Rapier of the Dark Swashbuckler
Description: "She disappeared as soon as she arrived, leaving a trail of corpses in her wake."

Name: Bard's Tale
Description: "Gather around and listen to my story."

Name: Ancient Yardstick
Description: "Measurements were essential to the experiments of the Ancients."

Name: Cloth Adorned Rapier
Description: "Silk tendrils flow from the handle of the rapier. A beautiful weapon as elegant as it is precise."

Name: Elegant Stick
Description: "A whitled down stick used by children as a rapier. It's sharp enough to be somewhat dangerous."

Name: Enchanted Sabre
Description: "A mage blessed the metal before it was forged, leaving a magically imbued blade that presents a danger to all."

Name: Faeforged Rapier
Description: "Lightweight with immeasurable strength."

Name: Fiery Rapier
Description: "Sparks dance from the blade."

Name: Forgotten Competition Rapier
Description: "Dueling is a remarkably popular past time in Aeternum. One duelist was defeated so badly he left his settlement, leaving this rapier behind."

Name: Glassforged Rapier
Description: "Were this blade any thicker it would be impractical. But the glass makes a fine point that is perfect for thrusting at your enemies."

Name: Gutsticker
Description: "One thrust and I'll have won our duel."

Name: Iceforged Rapier
Description: "Quickly cooled and enchanted with the power of the tundra."

Name: Lightless Rapier
Description: "The weapon absorbs the light that shines on it."

Name: Overly Sharp Crystal
Description: "It's really sharp."

Name: Stormbound Sabre
Description: "Find me in the storm."

Name: Twisted Metal Rapier
Description: "Three prongs of metal are curved and twisted together forming one strong blade."

Name: Decorative Rapier
Description: "Not overly sharp and not particularly well balanced. But it'll do in a pinch."

Name: Master Cannoneer's Rapier
Description: While the scabbard and grip are splattered with dried blood, the blade seems to have hardly been used.

Name: Balanced Blade
Description: "Well balanced for combat."

Name: Smoldering Rapier
Description: "Left in the forge a bit too long."

Name: Lightning Piercer
Description: "Let the power of the storm flow through you."

Name: Deceit of the Defiler
Description: "She double crossed us and burned our ships, a deception we never saw coming."

Name: Overseer's Servant
Description: "You are at my disposal."

Name: The Backstabber
Description: "Foes of Mattheson never saw the killing blow. Indeed, they didn't even know they were enemies, until the blade slid home."

Name: Holt's Fillet Knife
Description: "Sharp enough that even a clumsy brute wields it effectively."

Name: Fleshneedle
Description: "Stitch yourself up and get back in the fight."

Name: Weaver's Needle
Description: "Fast as a weaver's shuttle, it flicks back and forth at its foes."

Name: Blackened Blade
Description: "A solid black blade fit for an outlaw."

Name: Blade of the Lost Duelist
Description: "In life he was bold and few could challenge him. He carries this same hubris in undeath."

Name: Breachguard's Bane
Description: "Defend this monument to corruption at your own risk."

Name: Crystalsticker
Description: "Poke."

Name: Ethereal Conduit
Description: "Ghosts seem drawn to the weapon.""

Name: Forest's Whisper
Description: "Rangers traversed the forest keeping an ear to the ground, listening for who or what was nearby."

Name: Glacial Shard
Description: "Ripped from a glacier deep within the permafrost, the frigid rapier freezes those who are on the wrong end of it."

Name: Grim Luck
Description: "Better luck next time."

Name: Jolly Sabre
Description: "Oh how happy I am when I am out plundering."

Name: Precisely Engineered Rapier
Description: "This rapier is so precisely crafted it can cut a single hair off of your head with a swing."

Name: Shattered Perception
Description: "Things are not always as they seem."

Name: Trusted Sideblade
Description: "Never leave home without your rapier."

Name: Incanted Point
Description: Enchanted metals are a mages best friend.

Name: Sharktooth
Description: "Sharper than a shark's tooth, faster than a sailfish's strike."

Name: Hallowed Rapier
Description: "A revered weapon among the templars."

Name: Rootspike
Description: "The tree grew roots as sharp as razors."

Name: Tuskgorer
Description: "Like the tusks of a boar, this rapier is known for drawing first blood when cornered."

Name: Cruel Delight
Description: "While others enjoyed more pleasant hobbies, Abraxis took his love of torture to new depths."

Name: Swiftstrike Blade
Description: “You may be stronger, but I am faster.”

Name: Archmage's Steel Wand
Description: "The archmage imbued his rapier with such power that it became a living conduit for arcane energy."

Name: Friend of Darkness
Description: "You think darkness is your ally?"

Name: Tactician's Rapier
Description: "The first step to winning the war is having a flawless battle plan."

Name: Starmetal Lightning Rod
Description: "Raise your weapon to the sky and grasp my power."

Name: Wicked Watcher's Rapier
Description: "He was derelict in his duties, and hundreds died because of him."

Name: Feral Demeanor
Description: "They fight with a savagery that we have not seen before."

Name: Tearsteal Rapier
Description: "Do not cry for me."

Name: Philippe's Poker
Description: "Philippe was cruel to the prisoners he held, tormenting them every day."

Name: Ageless Blade
Description: “Time has no effect on this weapon. It's as new as it was the day it was forged.”

Name: Barnacle Crusted Blade
Description: "Barnacles grow on the hilt of the rapier, the end result of a decade at the bottom of a shipwreck."

Name: Blazing Rapier
Description: "When drawn from its sheathe, the rapier ignites."

Name: Cherished Memory
Description: "No matter what may happen between us, I will remember you fondly."

Name: Consecrated Rapier
Description: "Bless this blade, and guard whomever may wield it."

Name: Crimson Guard
Description: "Conviction guards against weakness, as the dawn guards against the night."

Name: Cutwater Rapier
Description: "The chosen weapon of the Cutwater pirates."

Name: Cyclopian Eye Gouger
Description: "The cyclops is no easy foe, but know where to stick your weapon and it will be blind to all that you may do to it."

Name: Fallen Star
Description: "Forged from the remains of a star that fell into the earth, leaving some foreign glowing metal behind."

Name: Forever Mourning
Description: "We've lost so many of our friends. How many more will we lose?"

Name: Forsworn Rapier
Description: “I need nothing in life but you.”

Name: Iced Slicer
Description: "With ice in my veins I will hunt you down."

Name: Keeper's Rapier
Description: "May the watcher guide your path."

Name: Lieutenant General's Blade
Description: “My legions are vast. This continent is ours to conquer."

Name: Manskewer
Description: “Strick them with the pointy end.”

Name: Rapier of the New Dynasty
Description: "We shall forge a new, more perfect order."

Name: Void-Forged Rapier
Description: "The dark smiths of the Cleave forged this weapon so that their armies might lay waste to those who would oppose them."

Name: Wailing Blade
Description: "After the siege had ended, the sound of fighting stopped and the sound of crying began."

Name: Wingslicer
Description: "Remove a butterflies wings and it cannot fly."

Name: Woodsman's Rapier
Description: "He always entered the forest with a sword at his side."

Name: Contrition
Description: Never can we be completely washed of sin.

Name: Renaissance
Description: "Take this knowledge and be reborn."

Name: Honorbound Rapier
Description: "Honor above all else."

Name: Needler
Description: "Sew some clothes or stitch some flesh, it's all the same to me."

Name: Voidbringer's Rapier
Description: "Let darkness into your heart and see the light."

Name: Adiana's Fury
Description: "All the fury of the Angry Earth was channeled through her."

Name: Ancient Tales
Description: "It's a tale as old as time. Two people fight and only one walks away alive."

Name: Assassination Blade
Description: "Depose the king, depose the queen, it's all the same to me. So long as there is coin in my pocket, I will kill whoever you ask."

Name: Atlas Killer
Description: "Sometimes large destruction comes in small packages."

Name: Blade of a Thousand Cuts
Description: "No single strike shall kill you. Your death shall be the sum of the whole."

Name: Blightprick
Description: "A single drop of blight is enough to kill anyone."

Name: Bloodfeast
Description: "Drink the blood of your foes."

Name: Burning Passion
Description: "The things you do for love."

Name: Changeling's Rapier
Description: "What form I take is of no concern to you."

Name: Coalesced Void Rapier
Description: "The rapier appears to be a living organism formed from solidified void energy."

Name: Crème De La Crème
Description: Cuts anything like butter, swipes with this Rapier are smooth and creamy.

Name: Dark Days
Description: "Things will get worse before they get better."

Name: Darkforged Void Sabre
Description: "The dark energies pulsing through this rapier are intense, enticing even."

Name: Diplomacy
Description: "Perhaps my blade will allow us to come to an agreement."

Name: Energized Ancient Rapier
Description: "The blade reverberates when it strikes metal."

Name: Fay's Covenant
Description: "May the bearer of this rapier watch over the land's bounty and protect it from those who would cause imbalance."

Name: Fever
Description: "The fever took him by storm, draining him of all his energy."

Name: First Mate's Rapier
Description: "As you are the right hand of the captain, so is this weapon your right hand."

Name: Flash of Light
Description: "And in an instant, she was gone."

Name: Fleshsplicer's Rapier
Description: "Cut the flesh from your foes and forge them anew."

Name: Foretold Fate
Description: "I always knew this day would come."

Name: Forever Frost
Description: "Venture far enough north and you will find the land of forever frost."

Name: Forgotten Remnant
Description: "Cast aside who or what you once were. You belong to Aeternum now."

Name: Godfall
Description: "Mortal, god... None can hope to stand against me."

Name: Grandmaster Duelist's Rapier
Description: "Decades of practice led to this. No one could win a duel against the grandmaster."

Name: Harbinger of the End
Description: "When we saw the creature standing at our gate, we knew the end was here."

Name: Hopelessness
Description: "Let the dread wash over you. All hope is lost."

Name: Icicle
Description: "Pure ice."

Name: Jolly Roger's Rapier
Description: "See my colors fly and know that I come for you."

Name: Last Blow
Description: "The only blow that matters is the one that ends the fight."

Name: Last Hope
Description: "We have exhausted all other options. Force is all we have left."

Name: Lightning Call
Description: "Strike before they can hear you."

Name: Lightning's Splendor
Description: "It's as beautiful as it is powerful."

Name: Longevity
Description: "May you live a long and prosperous life."

Name: Motherwell Wisher's Wand
Description: "It brings long life to the bearer, and short life to their enemies."

Name: Ode to the Fallen
Description: "Remember and honor those who came before us."

Name: Isabella's Rapier
Description: "How many has Isabella slain with this? No matter, it's yours now, and the count can begin afresh."

Name: Piercing Cold
Description: "The cold bites deep."

Name: Putrid Fishbone
Description: "Like a fishbone stuck in the back of your throat, it's best not to imagine how long this rapier has been moldering inside Putris's maw.

Name: Queensguard
Description: "Lay down your life for your queen if you must!"

Name: Rapier of Arcane Tricks
Description: "What's up my sleeve? Youll see soon enough."

Name: Rapier of the Grand Champion
Description: "At the end of the melee there was but one person left standing."

Name: Rapier of the Linen Duelist
Description: "It matches your hat!"

Name: Rapier of the Summer Solstice
Description: "One day a year, when the sun was closest to the earth, fire reigned supreme."

Name: Razorfang
Description: "The fang of a massive wolf that was whitled down into a weapon."

Name: Reach of the Empire
Description: "The corrupted empire knows no territory, no boundaries. Our reach is endless."

Name: Rotten Rapier
Description: "Rust has caused a number of holes in the weapon, but it still works."

Name: Ruination
Description: "You have brought the end to us all."

Name: Sabre of the Dark Cultist
Description: "Incantations aren't always enough, sometimes a bit of steel is required to finish a spell."

Name: Shallow Grave
Description: "They'll find your corpse eventually."

Name: Silver Tongue's Rapier
Description: "If my words do not persuade you, perhaps my sword shall."

Name: Siren's Marcato
Description: "Louder and louder the strikes landed, creating a symphony of pain."

Name: Siren's Rapier
Description: "The sirens were fine duelists, whether it be with spears of rapiers. Few could stand against them."

Name: Sleight of Hand
Description: "I am here, then I am not."

Name: Slice n' Dice
Description: "A little slash here, a little slash there..."

Name: Soulneedle
Description: "Pierce through the flesh and into the soul."

Name: Southern Wind
Description: "The wind will blow away your ashes."

Name: Spriggan Slicer
Description: "You cut the vine and it regrows faster and stronger to kill you with."

Name: Stormbreak
Description: "The sun peeked through the clouds promising a brighter future."

Name: Suave Swashbuckler's Rapier
Description: "Why must we fight? Let us talk!"

Name: Swan Song
Description: "This is your finale."

Name: Tour de Pain
Description: "Oh how much you can truly hurt."

Name: Troubador
Description: "Come, sing us a song."

Name: Veronica's Justice
Description: "Whatever sort of justice the world had, she had other ideas."

Name: Wartorn Rapier
Description: "This rapier has seen endless conflict."

Name: Watcher's Dutybound Rapier
Description: "The oath you swore means you will stand guard for all time, greeting newcomers to this land and defending us from whatever horrors wash ashore."

Name: Wavepiercer
Description: "Crash through the waves. Endure, and come out the other side."

Name: Wedding Tribute
Description: "This weapon was a gift for the bride to be. Instead it would be her undoing."

Name: Weightless Sabre
Description: "So light it is as if you are holding nothing at all."

Name: When They Come
Description: "The day all settlements fear is when the corrupted show up at your doorstep."

Name: Entrée
Description: Its many wielders believed battle to be a graceful dance.

Name: Hunter's Claw
Description: "Rend its flesh and retreat to safety. Let it wear itself out."

Name: Aristocrat's Calling
Description: The weapon of a refined duelist.

Name: Mange
Description: Maybe...maybe don't touch this one...

Name: Harrow's Pincer
Description: It sweeps across the ground like rays of light from the sun.

Name: Revenge of the Scorned
Description: Love and hate are two sides of the same coin.

Name: Appointed Negotiator
Description: "Karl never gave orders without having his Appointed Negotiator around. It never failed to stop arguments before they started."

Name: Dryad Walking Stick
Description: "Useful for climbing steep hills or fending off unwanted companions."

Name: Pigsticker
Description: "Perfect for hunting boar and roasting them afterwards."

Name: Olcott Cutter
Description: "Originally used for hunting animals, over time it became something that struck fear into the hearts of people and animals alike."

Name: Forthright
Description: "Direct and to the point. Take this path to victory."

Name: Captain's Call
Description: "All hands on deck!"

Name: Corrupted Skewer
Description: "The corrupted do not treat us as humans. They see us only as pigs to be slaughtered."

Name: Diamond's Head
Description: "The head of a spear is an odd use for such a precious gem, though I suppose it is rather sharp."

Name: Faefolk's Spear
Description: "Beautiful flowers and vines adorn every corner of this weapon. It is as enchanting as it is deadly."

Name: Forest's Guide
