Description: The sun reflects off your armor to blind the heretics you war against.

Name: Aureate's Golden Braccae
Description: The sun reflects off your armor to blind the heretics you war against.

Name: Aureate's Golden Caligae
Description: The sun reflects off your armor to blind the heretics you war against.

Name: Aureate's Golden Manica
Description: The sun reflects off your armor to blind the heretics you war against.

Name: Hand of Jupiter
Description: It was named by a frightened legion soldier who had never seen such magic before.

Name: Rapier of Forgotten Queens
Description: "Buried among the tombs of queens past, forgotten among the masses of generous rulers the realm had known."

Name: Promise of Power
Description: "Do not resist. I possess that which you desire."

Name: Farseer's Spear
Description: "Gaze into my crystals and see your future."

Name: Dreadwake
Description: “The feared pirate commander succumbed to the corruption. His ship would appear around the shores of Aeternum, his axe in hand, and all that followed was death and destruction.”

Name: Glowing Lifecrystal Staff
Description: "The crystal tipped staff radiates pure life energy, healing all around it."

Name: Flamewake
Description: "All that remains in my path is ash and dust."

Name: Tempest's Call
Description: "She called for me to find Her, and so I left a trail of blood in my wake as I sought Her out."

Name: Taiyings Heart
Description: "Ambition. Loss. Victory. Defeat. The heart endures."

Name: Zealous Embrace
Description: "May you find others who seek your cause, and the power to destroy those that do not."

Name: Accursed End
Description: "Your destiny was never your own. From the beginning my curse was upon you."

Name: Frostforged War Hammer
Description: "The entire weight of the tundra lingers behind your swing."

Name: Bow of the Enchantress
Description: "Sing my song and receive my power."

Name: Madman's Headhunter
Description: "None are safe when the madman is on the loose."

Name: Inner Peace
Description: "Now that your enemies are dead, I hope you find peace."

Name: Pirate's Piece
Description: The extra loudness intimidates its foes.

Name: Wodao
Description: A sword shipped in from faraway from Aeternum. It is of excellent make, as many have safely staked their lives on it in the past.

Name: Duplicitous Intent
Description: "My intentions surely are pure."

Name: Rejected Sacrifice
Description: "Not good enough. NOT. GOOD. ENOUGH. Begone, and show your face here no longer!"

Name: Ethereal Visage
Description: "A faint image stained her sight, giving glimpses of a promising future. Or perhaps, her forgotten past."

Name: Willing Sacrifice
Description: “They endlessly throw themselves upon our blades, but for what purpose?"

Name: Corruption's Resurgence
Description: "We thought that corruption was gone, dying a slow death. And then out of nowhere, it erupted."

Name: Voidsong
Description: "Listen closely and hear my promises of power."

Name: Corruption Infused Longbow
Description: "Corruption seeps from the wood around the bow, oozing from every bow. Knocking an arrow causes the corruption to jut towards the fresh wood, trying to corrupt every last splinter of it."

Name: Thorpe's Helmet
Description: Once deeply infused with corruption, it now seems to offer protection against that same dark power.

Name: Desecrated Maul
Description: "An unholy presence lingers around this War Hammer. What was once a weapon of virtue and justice now serves a far darker purpose."

Name: Dark Pyromancer's Spellstaff
Description: "The coven's pyromancers were among the most powerful beings on Aeternum, controlling forces that were not meant to be controlled."

Name: Abyssal Strike
Description: "A weapon of justice and holy intent turned into a weapon of malice."

Name: Frostwall
Description: "A winter storm ebbs and flows within you. Attune yourself to it, and you will find a font of power."

Name: Tundra Warden's Rifle
Description: "Strange beasts lurk on the fringes of the tundra. You never know what you'll run into."

Name: Cave Crawler
Description: It was so named by a frightened adventurer who mistook this gun for a monstrous grub.

Name: Bloodblade
Description: While not forged in blood, it does certainly seem to have an affinity for the substance.

Name: Droplet
Description: A favorite of many sailors as mass-produced goods remind them of home.

Name: Damp
Description: You can feel the cold claiming your finger.

Name: Teardrop
Description: A tear shed for a soul lost.

Name: Iridescence
Description: It shines brightly enough to keep wayward souls at bay.

Name: Brinicle
Description: The cold is freezing you, arm first.

Name: Grasp
Description: Its grip will never leave you.

Name: Expanse
Description: It hates to be confined. It's time to set it free.

Name: Melting Point
Description: Its heat will be comforting in the Deep.

Name: Soul Spine
Description: A poor lost soul has lost more than its purpose.

Name: Maul of Fathoms
Description: It bears the weight of the seas, and will not let you forget it.

Name: Priscilla's Shield
Description: Stolen from a tragic corpse by the seas that pounded it.

Name: Driftwood
Description: Brittle and infectious. I wouldn't use it personally, but to each their own.

Name: Arrowspine
Description: Weak wood usually doesn't make for a strong bow.

Name: Deep Hole
Description: It only gets darker the further down you go.

Name: Explorer's Friend
Description: A practical tool for any intrepid explorer.

Name: The Hook
Description: A pirate's best friend. As dangerous as it is intimidating.

Name: Brodesode
Description: Named by a man who had lost most of his teeth. It stayed in his possession about as long as his molars.

Name: Quaint Helm
Description: A simple piece of armor, favored by its wearer for its cost.

Name: Waterlogged Shirt
Description: You hesitate to put this on as it drips all over you.

Name: Shoes of Seine
Description: Waterlogged and mushy, but it at least doesn't seem to be seawater inside the soles.

Name: Lost Souls Gloves
Description: Souls have never been good at keeping track of their belongings it seems.

Name: Wanderers Pants
Description: Their wearer wandered the world, and these pants wandered the seas.

Name: Song of the Sea
Description: The sword seems to quietly hum in its scabbard to a strangely familiar tune.

Name: Firewood
Description: Forests shiver at its name.

Name: Tear of Aset
Description: It is said to have dropped from the eye of the mother.

Name: Soulbinding Band
Description: It does not bind two souls together, but instead, a soul to a form.

Name: Priestess Charm
Description: A protective charm used by a powerful priestess. It is said that this charm is what gave her the terrifying strength she was known for, but only ever said in whispers.

Name: Staff of the Throne
Description: The staff of the mother who protects this land.

Name: Hand of Jupiter
Description: It was named by a frightened legion soldier who had never seen such magic before.

Name: Claw of Orcus
Description: Such dark power can only come from the underworld.

Name: Mnevin Staff
Description: This staff was used to worship the bull-god of a long dead civilization. The god's true name has been lost to time.

Name: Dja of Bes
Description: A sturdy spear any soldier can rely on.

Name: Beastfang
Description: Such weapons are a rarity in the sands.

Name: Ornament of Legates
Description: This weapon was brought as ornamentation by a foolish commander.

Name: Wall of Stone
Description: "We shall be as the stone. Immovable and immutable."

Name: Ligo
Description: A simple tool meant for digging and construction.

Name: Charioteer's Bow
Description: A weapon as revolutionary as this cannot be lost to time. None shall forget it.

Name: Buchis Rage
Description: The rage of a beast lives within this weapon.

Name: Arquebus
Description: How did such a strange weapon arrive in this sandy land?

Name: Sobek's Hunger
Description: You feel your stomach emptying slowly as you swing this axe.

Name: Legate's Pride
Description: The pride of the invading soldiers is shown with this spoil of war.

Name: Darion's Spatha
Description: This sword was better cared for than anything else Darion had. It will serve you well for many years if you care for it as well.

Name: The Blue Crown
Description: A powerful headdress worn by a powerful leader.

Name: Lorica Squamata
Description: Tough and reliable legion armor. This is a newer style that is still being experimented with.

Name: Simple Skirt
Description: The passage of time has strangely granted such a simple creation value to the people who found it. It's owner must not have thought much if they had lost it so easily in the sands.

Name: Honorable Shoes
Description: Shoes worn by nobles past. Whether or not they are truly honorable would be best answered by the masses.

Name: Guardian's Gauntlets
Description: These gauntlets will protect you well. Be sure to protect others in kind.

Name: Purefire
Description: "Nothing cleanses like a raging flame."

Name: Illwhisper
Description: Although its words are indistinguishable, you know it speaks of ill omens.

Name: Dusktear
Description: The night sky peeks out the wounds it makes.

Name: Swiftspark
Description: "At the snap of my fingers, sparks will fly."

Name: Soulflare
Description: "The most noble souls burn the brightest."

Name: Energizing Charm
Description: This earrings original purpose is unknown, but its beauty still inspires.

Name: Ribshatter
Description: Not even the mightiest armor will stop it from breaking bones.

Name: Lithespear
Description: An important piece of a long forgotten dance, yet lethal it remains.

Name: Dreadscream
Description: "A scream echoes, nobody is around to hear it."

Name: Scarlet Slayer
Description: No matter how much it's cleaned, its blade remains scarlet stained.

Name: Razortrick
Description: A relic from a time of subterfuge and trickstabs.

Name: Culling Burn
Description: "A controlled burn keeps the forest healthy."

Name: Thunder's Roar
Description: Each shot deafens with its fury.

Name: Blazeclaw
Description: Its infernal grasp is strong, ready for the most brutal engagement.

Name: Meteor's Impact
Description: "The stars plummet, for I asked them to."

Name: Forest Stalker's Earring
Description: "Stick to the trees and stay out of sight."

Name: Timberleech
Description: Subtle hints of life crawl all across the wood.

Name: Bushfire
Description: "All it could do was spread and consume."

Name: Swarmbuster
Description: Strength in numbers is meaningless against a hammer such as this.

Name: Cornerstorm
Description: "Back against the wall, I cry out, and she listens."

Name: Sharp Static
Description: As you sleep the ring on, your hair stands on end.

Name: Static Shock
Description: You feel its charge flow through you, seeking an enemy.

Name: Frostsurge
Description: A cool wind blows, and the gauntlet pulses with power.

Name: Ancestor's Blessing
Description: "Go. Make us proud."

Name: Bonewrecker
Description: Devastate your foes by wrecking their very foundation.

Name: Spirittrap
Description: "There is no escape for the spirits I hunt."

Name: Nimbolt
Description: "With a flash of light, I have let loose a dozen arrows."

Name: Cindersweep
Description: Witness the beauty of the flames, streaking across the sky with each swipe.

Name: Butcher's Delight
Description: "Keep them coming, I can cleave all day."

Name: Feral Cleaver
Description: "My only fear is running out of foes to cleave."

Name: Lightning's Whisper
Description: "What did you say? I couldn't hear you."

Name: Grip of Decay
Description: All flesh succumbs to the void within its grasp.

Name: Nimble Eye
Description: A keen eye protects from even hidden dangers.

Name: Vortex Cannon
Description: Emboldened by the void, its booming shots wreak havoc.

Name: Gloomfury
Description: "A dark cloud approaches the battlefield. Gloomfury has arrived."

Name: First Freeze
Description: "We thought we were ready for the winter, but nothing could prepare us for this."

Name: Righteous Heart
Description: "The righteous shall prosper, for their strength lies deep."

Name: Mystic Sting
Description: "One precise sting was enough, he would never fear again."

Name: Plaguehunt
Description: "The hunt is on, and the cure is gone."

Name: Stormscorcher
Description: "I sit at the eye of the storm, a tempest of flames surrounds me."

Name: Nimble Heart
Description: "The heart dances, so that it may lift the hearts around it."

Name: Sparking Ring
Description: Sparks fly from the surface of this ring when even lightly grazed by metal.

Name: Crosshack
Description: With the right technique, it yields unfathomable power.

Name: Grimsand
Description: "Fate shifts and settles like sand, yet I fight on."

Name: Spelldancer
Description: "Join me for this dance?"

Name: Lost Shiver
Description: Its presence is felt, a tingle on the back of your neck.

Name: Agonizer
Description: "They will suffer, just as I have."

Name: Illspirit
Description: "My soul aches, with no remedy in sight."

Name: Voidstealer
Description: "All you hold dear is nothing in the face of the void."

Name: Spiritpool
Description: "Spirits stew so that great power may come forth."

Name: Blastdrain
Description: Nothing escapes the pull of its earthshattering grenades.

Name: Stubborn Cyclone
Description: "For as long as I stand, I will fight."

Name: Deadeye's Defiance
Description: "I will never miss again."

Name: Swifthail
Description: "No matter how clear the sky, violent hail is just a moment away."

Name: Scourge of the Depths
Description: "I know not where this blight came from. I pray that we never find out."

Name: Unyielding Cleaver
Description: Flesh, armor, bone. Its all the same to a blade that never wavers.

Name: Grimbolt
Description: Even a missed strike instills deep dread.

Name: Infernal Dread
Description: You feel a deep discomfort at the power emanating from this staff.

Name: Spinechiller
Description: As long as its wielded, the tingle on your spine never ceases.

Name: Second Strike
Description: "The first was just to soften them up."

Name: Hunter's Grace
Description: "I leap from tree to tree, my mark never escaping my eyes."

Name: Companion's Courage
Description: "She will never falter, as long as they're by her side."

Name: Shizaru's Lance
Description: A sturdy Lance, wielded by Shizaru The Storm.

Name: Fist of Stercus
Description: Heavy fists rained down, blow after blow.

Name: Sprout of Life
Description: The greatest trees often start as the smallest acorns.

Name: Rulav's Bite
Description: The edge on this axe is as keen as the laugh of its former owner.

Name: Felicia
Description: The words "For My Love" are inscribed under the guard.

Name: Hawkish Rebuke
Description: The keenest eye matched with the quickest draw. No one could challenge them together.

Name: Ten Penny Tenny
Description: Ten Pence for the Barman, Ten for the Undertaker.

Name: Stephanus' Masterpiece
Description: He struck the iron for fifteen days. The irons and anvils crumbled, but he stayed strong.

Name: Baldwyn's Rage
Description: Never step between a forgemaster and their work. You're liable to lose a limb.

Name: Eye of the Storm
Description: They'll never forget the stench of powder and the heat of the blast.

Name: Frost of the North
Description: A cold wind blows. An ice crystal grows.

Name: Deadly Reach
Description: Remember that your arm is bolstered by a meter of cold steel.

Name: The Oldest Way
Description: I am but a healer. I think nothing of the promises of men.

Name: Mizaru's Needle
Description: The cut is not meant to be deep, not at first.

Name: Deadblow
Description: Rocks broken, armor cracked. All that remains is a stern reminder of the death blow.

Name: Storming Sea
Description: A tempest by any other name is still a danger.

Name: The Cutlass' Word
Description: Let it be the last word a commander must use.

Name: Devouring Hand
Description: Consume. Consume. Consume.

Name: The Blizzard's Will
Description: I fear to tread where the snow tries to push me.

Name: Scorching Iron
Description: A fine, if rather blackened and charred, old musket.

Name: The Sun in Winter
Description: Where there is light there is heat.

Name: Gawain's Defiance
Description: A towering defense. Only conquered once.

Name: Fireblast
Description: A friendly-looking staff.

Name: Mary's Pain
Description: It is a shield that has weathered countless blows.

Name: Turkey's Bane
Description: "If turkeys have nightmares, it's nightmares of this."

Name: Tremendous Shout
Description: "Hey, over here! No not that way! To the left! No, my left, not your left!"

Name: Assassin's Flugelhorn
Description: "A clever killer finds many solutions to the same problem before committing to one."

Name: The Tipping Point
Description: "The first time this trigger was squeezed, it started a war."

Name: Troublemaker
Description: "Some people make trouble, some people solve trouble. This does both."

Name: Tempestuous Poetry
Description: "She whispers like an ocean storm."

Name: A Stunning Silence
Description: "There's a moment after the shot when nothing can hear anything."

Name: Rabbit Hunter's Blunderbuss
Description: "Whatever its initial purpose, this weapon has moved onto more sinister things."

Name: The Thunderbuss
Description: "What's in a name?"

Name: Troublemaker 9000
Description: "A true warrior would have immediately asked about the little, red lever on the side of the gun."
